title: Inherited rental — depreciation RESTARTS, decedent's does not carry over
catches: The requirements document's own flag wording, which is misleading here.

expected.requiredFlagText: Inherited rental property. Depreciation restarts on the adjusted basis as of the date of death; the decedent's prior depreciation generally does not carry over. Only the heir's own post-inheritance depreciation is relevant on a later sale.
expected.mustNotSay: Depreciation history may affect sale treatment
exceptionsToFlagSeparately: IRC 1014(b)(9) - heir depreciated the property before the death

notes: Reg. 1.1250-3(b): on a transfer at death the additional depreciation is ZERO and the holding period begins the day after death. The source document's suggested wording implies the decedent's depreciation history matters to the heir. It generally does not. Two exceptions get their own flags.
